text: BAM share fell 0.13 percentage points over 24 hours, while the move over 7 days is up 0.07 percentage points, leaving BAM at 32.8% of Solana stake. The top node, ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee, holds 23.3% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3, so concentration is elevated. The 61 top-node leadership changes this window are whale-driven routing, not structural rollover evidence.
